title: Implement --backend flag override for feature command
description: When --backend <name> is provided to rocket feature, use the specified backend instead of the default. Validate the backend name and show a helpful error for invalid values.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket feature 'test' --backend claude uses Claude backend for AI calls
rocket feature 'test' --backend invalid prints an error and exits non-zero
Valid backend names: copilot, claude, docker

steps.details: const VALID_BACKENDS = ['copilot', 'claude', 'docker']; if (options.backend && !VALID_BACKENDS.includes(options.backend)) { console.error(`Invalid backend: ${options.backend}. Valid options: ${VALID_BACKENDS.join(', ')}`); process.exit(1) }
const backend = options.backend === 'claude' ? claudeBackend : options.backend === 'docker' ? dockerBackend : copilotBackend. Pass this backend to clarifier.ts and specGenerator.ts.
